title: Yitzchak bar Ostaya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Yevamot, at the beginning of chapter 1 (Hyman’s printed locator is רפ״א־ג). He reports a question posed by Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish. He may be Rabbi Yitzchak Atushaya. See that entry.

notes.text: The printed locator רפ״א־ג is not silently converted to a modern halakhah number. The terse report formula and possible identification remain open source questions.

Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 1:1 calls the reporter Yitzchak bar Istayah. He reports Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish’s question about listing sixteen women. The Mechon Mamre text places the line at 3b, in chapter 1, halakhah 1. Seder HaDorot uses the name Ostaya and cites chapter 1, halakhah 1. The separate mourning accounts in Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:5 and Nazir 3:1 name Yitzchak Atushaya or, in another version, his son Chiyya. Hyman’s identification of Ostaya with Atushaya remains tentative.
